latest_release.name: v0.15.1 — Credit codes, server-side Goals, proactive Spaces, and image-heavy session fixes
latest_release.body:
Credit codes, server-side Goals, proactive Spaces, and image-heavy session fixes

Credit codes, server-side Goals, proactive Spaces, and image-heavy session fixes

### New
- Credit codes: redeem a code at `/redeem` for credits, and a `/redeem?code=` link survives sign-up. Admins create codes with an expiry and a redemption limit. (#11939, #11944, #11945)
- Goals run on the API: goal state lives on the server, and only a verifier session can mark a goal done. Goals are in the command palette. (#11910, #11882)
- Proactive Spaces: a watcher reads a Space's event feed and speaks up only when it matters. A Space's agents are its router's team; the router does quick work itself and links results as files. (#11865, #11861)
- Every agent gets its session ids, and a subagent can read its parent's conversation. (#11940)
- Watcher Apps: watcher health on the App page, links from a run to its event, one-trigger tests, and a silent or crashing watcher can wake a repair agent. Deleting an App removes the triggers that name it. (#11908, #11907, #11906)
- Hover Artifacts in the sidebar to open any artifact in one click. (#11905)

### Improved
- Spaces keep one conversation: agents read the thread's session log instead of copies. (#11896)
- Only production reports product analytics; dev and staging send nothing. (#11937, #11936)
- Old OpenCode-era code is removed. New audit rows of agent runtime events are named `agent.*` (old rows keep `opencode.*`): update a saved filter or SIEM rule on `opencode.`. (#11938)
- 35 Artifact fixes: comments, drawings, rename, conflicts, load errors, ⌘S retry, link cards, share, hit areas and screen readers. (#11911, #11912, #11916)
- The navbar GitHub link shows at every width; Goals buttons match the menu height. (#11887, #11884)

### Fixed
- Self-host updates apply migrations again: the API image ships every file the migration runner imports. (#11956)
- Image-heavy sessions no longer fail with "Input is too long", on Bedrock and in Claude Code sessions. (#11934, #11943)
- A session's Stop, probes and failed streams settle; a turn stays busy until it ends; one Stop sends one hold and one abort. (#11928, #11931)
- Session streams end on access loss and never bleed between sessions; client lifecycles survive restarts, stalls and transient errors. (#11929, #11925)
- Lifecycle status writes are compare-and-set, so a stale billing webhook never undoes a newer state. (#11932)
- A session created during a deploy gets a retryable 503 instead of a failure. (#11933)
- History recovery reads session stores larger than 256 MiB. (#11942)
- The Desktop panel stops blinking. (#11930)
- A click after the browser session went stale opens the page instead of the sign-in page. (#11922, #11921)
- An App's restart budget and crash episode, and an app trigger's silence window, survive a deploy or an edit. (#11917, #11909)
- Private channel threads and asks stay private. (#11868)
- A malformed JSON request body gets 400, not 500; a Composio HTML error page becomes a short 502; edge rate-limit headers stay on every route. (#11881, #11897, #11893)
- `send_message` drops a stray approve instead of refusing the message. (#11862)
- An unknown code-fence language renders as plain text. (#11883)

## What's Changed
* feat(spaces): a Space's agents are its router's team; the router does quick work itself and links results as files by @markokraemer in https://github.com/kortix-ai/CompanyOS/pull/11861
* fix(kortixd): send_message drops a stray approve instead of refusing the message by @markokraemer in https://github.com/kortix-ai/CompanyOS/pull/11862
* fix(release): manifest writes keep "all"; the v0.15.0 release suite goes green by @DimitrijeGlibic in https://github.com/kortix-ai/CompanyOS/pull/11863
* fix(ci): gitleaks allows pod checksums and the public PostHog client key by @DimitrijeGlibic in https://github.com/kortix-ai/CompanyOS/pull/11866
* feat(spaces): proactive Spaces — a watcher reads the Space's event feed and speaks up only when

detail.readme_excerpt:
# Kortix CompanyOS **The open-source CompanyOS: the cloud-native agent harness for companies.** Open Source  ·  Extensible  ·  Multiplayer  ·  Sovereign Always-on agents that start on events, run in parallel and share one memory of your company. Build custom agents on pi and ship them from one git repo. Schedules, webhooks, your tools' events and your team's messages start them. My Kortix routes the work, and swarms of agents run it in parallel, each on its own cloud computer with state that persists. Agents connect to 3,000+ apps, build and host the apps your company needs, and land every change through a review your team approves. Share agents and context across your whole team. Open source, any model, on your infrastructure or ours. [![GitHub stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/kortix-ai/CompanyOS?style=flat&color=111111&label=Stars)](https://github.com/kortix-ai/CompanyOS/stargazers) [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/kortix-ai/CompanyOS?style=flat&color=111111&label=Release)](https://github.com/kortix-ai/CompanyOS/releases/latest) [![Guide](https://img.shields.io/badge/Guide-kortix.com%2Fdocs-111111.svg)](https://kortix.com/docs/guide) [![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-111111.svg)](#contributing) [Website](https://kortix.com) · [Guide](https://kortix.com/docs/guide) · [Cloud](https://kortix.com/auth) · [AI Transformation](https://kortix.com/services) · [Manifesto](MANIFESTO.md)
--- ## A new kind of system An agent today is one chat session on one machine. It waits for a person to type. It blocks while a long job runs. Every task it takes on shares one context. It stops when the laptop sleeps. A person can follow only a few such sessions at once, so human attention runs out long before the model does. Kortix CompanyOS takes the session out of the person's hands. It is a **cloud-native agent harness**: you write custom agents on pi, an open-source agent harness, and Kortix deploys them to the cloud and supplies everything around the agent loop that one session cannot. | | | | --- | --- | | **Always on** | Compute and state are separate. Every session runs on its own cloud computer. The computer sleeps 15 to 20 minutes after the last turn and wakes on the next message or event, with its full history. State lives in the repo, in Drive, in the session's `/workspace` and in the session's record. | | **Event-driven** | Triggers start agents from schedules, signed
